as_told.title: E.T. based on a Kentucky farm family hiding an alien (Night Skies)

plain: A family in Kentucky is said to have found an alien on their farm and hidden it in their barn, and this case is said to have inspired Night Skies, a film Steven Spielberg was developing as a producer, which led to E.T. A guest Michels does not name tells it on two episodes in almost the same words, the second time as something passed on about Spielberg. Told this way, it would mean one of Hollywood's best-known alien films grew out of a reported real encounter.
